title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.24099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GUI agents often encounter dynamic anomalies when deployed on Android devices, from unexpected pop-ups to action misuse, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of agent robustness against runtime anomalies. We introduce AnTrap, a comprehensive benchmark that injects dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories. We propose a taxonomy organizing real-world anomalies into four layers (State, Thinking, Action and Round) with ten fine-grained subcategories, and develop a construction pipeline that preserves task solvability while introducing realistic adversarial conditions. Evaluating 16 leading GUI models, we reveal universal vulnerability to dynamic anomalies, with even the strongest models suffering significant performance degradation. translated_title: Android GUI智能体在运行时异常面前是否稳健？AnTrap：在动态对抗环境中评估智能体
translated_abstract: 摘要：GUI智能体在Android设备上部署时，常常会遇到动态异常，从意外的弹出窗口到操作误用，然而现有的基准测试缺乏对智能体在运行时异常下稳健性的系统评估。我们引入了AnTrap，一个全面的基准测试，它向智能体的执行轨迹中注入动态扰动。我们提出了一个分类体系，将现实世界中的异常组织为四个层次（状态、思考、动作和回合），包含十个细粒度子类别，并开发了一个构建流程，在保持任务可解性的同时引入现实的对抗条件。通过评估16个领先的GUI模型，我们揭示了它们对动态异常的普遍脆弱性，即使是最强大的模型也会遭受显著的性能下降。此外，我们在原始和对抗环境中进行了GRPO训练，以验证我们的基准测试，将环境可学习的异常与推理瓶颈的异常区分开来。
tldr: 该论文提出了AnTrap基准测试，系统性地评估Android GUI智能体对运行时动态异常的稳健性，并发现所有现有模型普遍存在脆弱性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AnTrap benchmark to systematically evaluate Android GUI agents' robustness against runtime dynamic anomalies, revealing universal vulnerability across all existing models.
